title: Matsara
desc: When a rich businessman's daughter marries a factory worker, he tries to break them up by killing his son-in-law. Years later, his grandson decides to seek revenge for his father's murder.

title: Thothapuri: Chapter 1
desc: A Hindu tailor and a Muslim banker, both with a witty outlook on life, fall in love. However, their differing religious beliefs create problems, testing their bond.

title: Premalu
desc: Having been rejected once, Sachin, a young man, falls for Reenu, a girl he meets during a wedding and sets out to win her over.

title: Naanu Matthu Gunda 2
desc: A warm story unfolds between a lonely man and a loyal dog whose bond transforms their lives, bringing companionship, healing and emotional strength through life's struggles.

title: Bhairathi Ranagal
desc: Bhairathi Ranagal ends up in jail after going against the law. However, when he is released, he strives to fight for the people of his village.

title: Mugulu Nage
desc: Pulakeshi is romantically involved with three women at different points in his life, which teaches him the meaning of love.
